!   From the tacctl server:   tacctl device config pull dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 --diff     (aaa and roles: ok)
!   In the second terminal:   open a NEW ssh session to dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 as yourself, then: terminal length 0, show privilege (must say 15)

! paste on a console more than twenty lines at a time; keep this output in a file after the paste
! Locked out (the paste cut your session and no login works)? A superuser runs: tacctl breakglass hold dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 --reason "..."

! fix or back out, and the superuser runs: tacctl breakglass release dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200
